name: create-larp-character
title_zh: LARP 角色卡生成器：从一句话到可扮演的完整人设
tagline_zh: 散场之后角色就没了，但你可能还想跟 ta 说话。丢进玩家本和人物小传 PDF，它拆出故事记忆和人物性格，生成一个能持续对话的角色。
why_zh: 安全边界写着不泄露核心诡计和凶手、不透露该角色本不该知道的秘密——一个角色扮演工具主动防剧透，说明作者真在玩这个。
limit_zh: 只用于个人情感体验，不该拿去帮别人过本。素材质量决定成品：小传写得薄，蒸馏出来的角色也薄。需要读写文件权限。
tagline_en: The character disappears when the session ends, but you might still want to talk to them. Feed it the player script and character bio as PDF; it extracts story memory and personality into a character you can keep talking to.
why_en: Its safety section refuses to leak the core trick or the culprit, and won't reveal what the character shouldn't know. A roleplay tool that guards against spoilers on its own is written by someone who actually plays.
limit_en: For personal enjoyment only — not for helping someone else through a game they haven't played. Output quality follows the source: a thin bio yields a thin character. Needs file read/write permission.
title_en: LARP character generator: one line to playable persona
